items.title: Eat a Cooked Meal
items.detail: Cook at any cooking station or buy from Mr Waiter/Ms Waitress at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Collect a Lighter, Cigarette or Cigar
items.detail: Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine at C.A.M.P. passively produces these items

items.title: Collect a piece of Bone
items.detail: Braxson's Quality Medical Supplies in the Mire has skeleton bones on shelves and tables

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team; Phantoms spawn near cabins and campgrounds during Slasher event

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Pick up Grunt Hunt bounty at Highway Town, finish with blade; easier than Head Hunt

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest
items.detail: Complete a public event first to get the quest; kills anywhere count, not just at grave

items.title: Use Photomode while in a Team
items.detail: Open Photomode settings while on any team and take a photo

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any small decoration or C.A.M.P. piece like a floor or stair from build menu

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: Pull from stash, craft with Ammosmith perk, or loot from enemies; Forward Station Tango is reliable

items.title: Craft Bulk Steel
items.detail: Craft at Tinker's Workbench using Steel scrap and Plastic

items.title: Craft Bulk Wood
items.detail: Craft at Tinker's Workbench using Wood scraps and Plastic

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Limb
items.detail: West Tek Research Center has dense Super Mutant spawns; use shotgun with Enforcer perk or rifle via V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Blackwater Mine is reliable spawn location; target the head as weak spot with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Head Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town Bounty Board; any bladed melee weapon counts, only final hit needs blade

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suit scraps and excavator power armor mod boxes at any workbench

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors; can craft and sell inexpensive grenades

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Double rewards for SCORE progress and caps earned from activities.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special events celebrating Fallout 76 anniversary with unique rewards.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Limited-time vendor rotation offering rare plans and items at discounted gold prices.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Double caps rewards and mutated enemy encounters with special loot drops.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events with mutated variants offering exclusive rewards from mutated packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience points earned from all activities for faster leveling.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27
events.description: Major update introducing world pets feature and launching Season 27 You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
